editorial:
You are dropped into a creepy hospital mystery when a woman’s body vanishes from the morgue with no clear explanation. Inspector Jaime Peña takes the case, and he soon pulls in Álex Ulloa, the widower of the missing woman. Their uneasy partnership gives the movie a tense, watchful mood, because every clue seems to point in a different direction. You feel the pressure build as questions pile up about what really happened before the body disappeared.

The acting keeps you locked in, especially the back-and-forth between the inspector and the widower. The pacing is steady rather than rushed, with enough twists to keep you guessing without losing the story. Some scenes may feel a little slow if you want nonstop action, and a few clues are easy to spot early. Still, it is a strong pick for mystery fans who enjoy dark, clever thrillers. Watch it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the investigation closes in on Álex, and the missing-body mystery is revealed as part of a larger trap. The twist shows that the dead woman’s disappearance was not random; it was designed to expose guilt and force a confession. Álex is left cornered as the truth comes out, and the last moments make it clear that the person everyone thought was a victim had been controlling the game all along.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark mystery thrillers with clever twists.
